scope: Every selected raw artifact read fully, integrity checked, parsed/scanned and content-classified before transmission. Synthetic inputs/output shapes and all receipt byte hashes verified; external source inspected.
normalization: Logs/metadata use CANDIDATE_ROOT, EVIDENCE_ROOT, EPHEMERAL_ROOT and NODE_EXECUTABLE placeholders; nonempty streams use one terminal newline. External executed source retained exactly; its generic task workspace paths contain no user information.
reportCorrection: Original REPORT.json preparation used proposedCopy for description and omitted its count object; publication restores explicit 33/33/0 from unchanged proposed-copy/summary.json and retains description separately.
exclusions: Original manifest/archive, private handover information, credentials, native/private messages, local personal paths, auth files, operating DB/WAL. No such excluded material is transmitted.
